name: Crony Letter ～Piqtat e Haru o Okuru～
original_name: クローニーレター ～ピックタットへ春を送る～
source:
Otto writes a letter to his family about what he's been up to.
Includes three stories:
One about a day when he was sick, one about a midnight talk with Garfiel, one just messing around with Subaru.
